_doc: Dialogue trees of 'Conversar' (DialogueRun, src/tycoon/talk/dialogue_run.gd; the box: CometlingDialogue). trees: {id: {start, nodes, menus}}. node: {lines: [{text_key, if, weight, pose, face}], choices: [...] or a menu id, effects: [...]}. choice: {text_key, goto, if, end, once, effects}. effects: {morale: n} (once a week per speaker), {flag: name}, {hint: true} (the tip goes into the Journal), {lesson: id} (Vovô replays a lesson), {say: key} (a bubble after the box closes). Which tree: the speaker node's metadata talk_tree, else by_legend[the Lenda's id], else legend for a Lenda, leader for the player's leader, else default. Conditions and placeholders: ChatterBook (src/tycoon/talk/chatter_book.gd).
